brief.claim: Applying the drug to brain slices increases the mean amplitude of synaptic responses relative to vehicle: mean response amplitude is higher with the drug than with vehicle, in slices taken from the same animals, at the two-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.meaning: response amplitude of each cell recorded in drug-treated tissue
response amplitude of each cell recorded in vehicle-treated tissue from the same animals

brief.sizes: 8 animals, 25 cells per condition per animal (200 cells per array).
